Once, we decided to bake a birthday cake together. From scratch. With absolutely the confidence you would expect from two people who had never done it before.

By the time we finished, the kitchen looked like a flour bag had exploded, and the cake had developed a noticeable lean. I suggested buying another one. Hannah turned the plate, studied it, and said, “There. That’s the front.”
